svg.title: Revision decisions: six simulated feedback items sorted into accept, defer and reject
svg.desc: FB-01, 02, 03 and 05 accepted and re-tested; FB-04 deferred; FB-06 rejected for this release. Each decision records observation, decision, rationale and verification. Simulated example.
svg.text: SIMULATED FEEDBACK · HOW EACH ITEM WAS DECIDED
Every piece of feedback gets a decision, a reason and a check
All feedback is simulated, authored teaching content; no completed user testing is implied.
